measurement_scope: The plan comparison uses the same recorded file and metadata root in the live database. End-to-end runs use the actual repository file; its OS metadata changed between some runs, so no claim is made that all end-to-end runs used the same file-occurrence ID. Final repeated fixed replay pruned its recorded file and wrote nothing. The corpus was not evicted from PostgreSQL buffers. No active cache or database coordinate changes were made. The whole-ingest timings belong to the earlier isolated candidate; current_operation_validation records the refreshed-source Native endpoint implementation separately.

current_operation_validation.execution: Exact SQL extracted from validate_file_contexts in the candidate Engine source. Candidate ICX-built PostgreSQL module and helper definitions were bound inside a rollback transaction on the actual laplace database. The writer places the context at its ordered metadata tail. Neither active module nor cache was replaced.

cases: POINT with a two-occurrence ss run
windows_real_database.path_only_column_acl: Passed with entity/path SELECT and no mask SELECT using a transaction-local role; all definitions, grants and role creation rolled back.

actual_code.scope: Actual source decomposition and byte recomposition with candidate Engine; no load. Latest complete Engine ingest is not claimed against the installed 1.38 API.

current_operation_validation.limits: Execution times are server EXPLAIN ANALYZE measurements; buffers were not evicted. This validates the existing database with candidate functions in rollback transactions, not installed deployment. PostgreSQL 1.39 and the Engine consumer must be integrated together. Tier-0 population restoration is a separate draft Native PR.

windows_module_regression.scope: Fresh private PostgreSQL install and upgrade, masks, geometry, GIN, GiST, text IDs, attestation and staged ingestion; active cluster untouched.
